scoring_justification: Recomputing the full DFT/DFPT workflow in the checker sandbox is infeasible; therefore the checker compares the agent's reported scalar outputs to the paper-reported gold values using absolute tolerances.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold values for lambda, omega_log, Tc, acoustic_fraction
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Fig.4(b) and main text: λ≈1.65, ω_log≈600 K, Tc≈23 K, acoustic_fraction≈20.2%.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted from the paper's reported computed quantities; the exact values match the reference solution's output.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Values are directly from the paper's reported results; the reference solution is designed to reproduce them.

outputs.description: The computed electron-phonon coupling constant λ, logarithmic average phonon frequency ω_log, superconducting critical temperature Tc from the McMillan-Allen-Dynes formula with μ*=0.19, and the fractional contribution of acoustic phonons (below 120 cm⁻¹) to λ.

output_contract.notes: The agent must run the full DFT/DFPT workflow to obtain λ(ω) and α²F(ω), then compute the four quantities. The hidden checker compares each value to the paper-reported gold within absolute tolerances. No gold values or tolerances are revealed here.

steps.description: Compare the agent-reported lambda, omega_log, Tc, and acoustic_fraction to the paper-reported gold values within absolute tolerances. Score is the fraction of fields that pass; full credit if all four pass.
